def test_partition__basic():
    # ---- Error: non‑iterable input ----
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as exc:
        partition(None)
    assert str(exc.value) == "expected an iterable"

    # ---- _make_key_func: string key (attribute lookup) ----
    class Item:
        def __init__(self, flag):
            self.flag = flag

    items = [Item(True), Item(False), Item(True)]
    true_items, false_items = partition(items, "flag")
    assert true_items == [items[0], items[2]]
    assert false_items == [items[1]]

    # ---- _make_key_func: invalid key type ----
    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as exc:
        partition([1, 2, 3], 5)  # int is neither str nor callable
    assert str(exc.value) == "expected key to be callable or a string"

    # ---- Happy path: default key (bool) ----
    assert partition([0, 1, 0, 2]) == ([1, 2], [0, 0])

    # ---- Happy path: multiple predicates ----
    # predicates: >0, <0 ; remaining go to last bucket (==0)
    pos, neg, zero = partition(range(-2, 3), lambda i: i > 0, lambda i: i < 0)
    assert pos == [1, 2]
    assert neg == [-2, -1]
    assert zero == [0]

    # ---- Verify return type and structure ----
    result = partition([1, 2, 3])
    assert isinstance(result, tuple)
    assert len(result) == 2  # one predicate + catch‑all
    assert result == ([1, 2, 3], [])  # all truthy go to first bucket
